FileSaver.js
============

Version : 2.0.5
Licence : MIT (see LICENSE.md in this folder)
Source  : https://github.com/eligrey/FileSaver.js

Obtained
--------
  npm install file-saver@2.0.5
  cp node_modules/file-saver/dist/FileSaver.min.js js/vendor/filesaver/

Copied unmodified. Exposes the global `saveAs`.

Changes made to upstream files: none. Byte-identical to the npm distribution.

See js/vendor/readme_moodle.txt for the full notes covering all three
libraries, licence compatibility and the upgrade procedure.
